description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_InventoryRestock"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupplierOrder" name="Supplier order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestock">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess"
                      name="Inventory restock process"
                      processRef="Process_InventoryRestock"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupplierOrder"
                      name="Supplier order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder"
                      targetRef="Participant_Supplier"
                      messageRef="Message_SupplierOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery"
                      name="Stock delivery"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Supplier"
                      targetRef="Event_ReceiveStock"
                      messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Inventory restock" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Begin inventory monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Stock at reorder threshold?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Signal need to reorder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Issue automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Reorder need signaled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place supplier order"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDates" name="Update expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StockDelivery"
                                   messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_NotReached" name="Below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockLevel < reorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Reached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockLevel >= reorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Automated" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Manual" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Automated_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_UpdateDates" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDates_ReceiveStock" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDates" targetRef="Event_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_PlaceStock" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceStock_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
